HexKagune 1.3.3 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 56). Testing build: compiled and tested, not tried in game.

- Talk screen reworked: the board rises in, her name is bigger with her mood as a coloured tag, and what she says is typed out with a soft voice, pausing at commas and longer at the end of sentences. Click, Space, Enter or a number key shows it all at once.
- The answers only slide in once she's finished talking, one after another.
- New bond meter: five bands from enemy to friend, the band you're in lit up, a heart that glides to where you stand, and what an answer did to your regard floating up off the heart (+3, -8).
- Holding hands: "Hold my hand." on her sweet page. She comes to your right side, takes your hand (your own arm reaches out to her) and walks with you wherever you go. Tap Shift to let go.
- Clinging: she now walks right up to your side and wraps her arms round your arm, staying there while she clings. If you walk off, she lets go. No more grabbing at the air from a step away.
- The kiss: she bends lower to meet you (holding Shift crouches you, which is why she looked tall), and when she pulls you in her arms go over your shoulders, not your face.
- Writing: she's always right-handed now, so the quill is in the hand that writes and the pocket book stays still.
- No fall damage for Eto (and every one-of-a-kind NPC after her).
- Her home is the Library, for good: she comes back there a day after she's killed, and if she's left away from it (waiting somewhere, following you, lost) with nobody around for a day, she goes back home by herself. Her partner is told.
- Someone else's partner now sees her mood as "cold".
